_doc: Phase 81.4 RESERVED write set (Codex review 2, P0) — 300 PT/EN messages authored AFTER the v1–v4 fixes with new moulds: formal/casual introductions, relocation verbs, job frames, birthdays, every preference family, pets (species, plurals, named negation), family, links, correction SEQUENCES (prior + expect + expect_clear), NEGATIVES (questions, third-party facts, hypotheticals, fiction, quotes, jokes, imperatives, predicates, past tense) and AMBIGUITIES that must write nothing. Run ONCE with scripts/run_write_set.py --set scripts/oracles/write_set_v5.json and reported as-is; v1–v4 are regression sets. Gate (ROADMAP 81.4): report P/C with CIs; no fixing on this set — a miss here becomes a regression case for the NEXT reserved set, never a patch measured on this one.
